descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92581 How it works 3; UAT TC-03 ER · “Room is the primary/default sort.”. Mixed: stated part — Both lists open on room order; searches list matches or say none; our part — List state after opening a chart and pressing Back, and across the two Nursing Home views (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S16 List after opening a chart and Back, and across Today's Visits ↔ All Residents, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Room is the primary sort: the list opens in room order, in both contexts (ticket How-it-works step 3: 'Room is the primary/default sort'). (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4)
  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture (one Hospital patient; one resident on Today's Visits)

When Hospital: open the list; type 'pneumonia' and choose the name sort; open {hospitalPatient}'s chart; press Back. Nursing Home: open Today's Visits; type 'zz-none'; open All Residents; clear the search, type 'QA Resident' and choose the name sort; open {snfResident}'s chart; press Back

Then Both lists open on room order. With a matching search the record is listed under the chosen sort. After Back the list is not empty and shows no no-match message. 'zz-none' on Today's Visits lists nobody and says so. No other-context record appears at any step

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 and cp4 mustContain the record and 'option "Sort: Room number" [selected]' (U3). cp2 and cp7 mustContain the record and 'option "Sort: Name A–Z" [selected]'. cp3 and cp8 mustContain the record and mustNotContain the no-match message. A list emptied or stuck on a no-match message after Back fails, whether or not the search was kept. …

Where it ran: dev unit U10; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
